info.name: Core accepted countries Account Refunds API

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which to retrieve refunds.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Beginning of the date range of the refunds to return.

params.name: end_date
params.description: End of the date range of the refunds to return.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of account refund resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.
Only supports `lastModifiedTime` and `-lastModifiedTime`.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `lastModifiedTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `updated_time`.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Array of statuses by which to filter refunds.

items.docs:
Use the `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/refunds` endpoint to retrieve an array of refunds on a credit account.

This endpoint supports <</core-api/sorting-and-pagination, sorting and pagination>>.

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which you want to create a balance refund.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

items.docs: Create a new refund, which you can issue to the account holder if their credit account balance is negative.

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which to retrieve a refund.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: refund_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the refund to retrieve.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/refunds/{refund_token}` to retrieve existing refunds.

items.docs: Use the `/accounts/{account_token}/refunds/{refund_token}` endpoint to retrieve a refund.

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which you want to transition a refund status.
Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: refund_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the refund whose status you want to transition.
Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts/{account_token}/refunds` endpoint to retrieve existing refund tokens for a given account.

items.docs: Use the `/accounts/{account_token}/refunds/{refund_token}/transitions` endpoint to transition a credit account refund's status to a new status.
